feedback.quotedText: Because zero gravity speeds up storytelling, it also helps gummy-worm listeners remember more.
feedback.comment: Your own results show nearly equal recall: 7.1 with gravity and 7.0 floating. The faster pace comes from the earlier study, not from your groups, and does not show that listeners remember more.
feedback.requestedChange: Report recall on its own and limit the conclusion to what this synthetic comparison measured.
